title: Catullus 51 — Ille mi par esse deo videtur
author: Gaius Valerius Catullus
edition_reference: Mynors OCT (R. A. B. Mynors, ed., C. Valerii Catulli Carmina, Oxford 1958)
constitutional_role: The Latin transform of Sappho 31. Four stanzas, not five. The fourth stanza (otium) transforms what Sappho's fifth stanza addressed. The constellation is the binary σ_S→σ_C.
